notes: Queue at start: 38 open stories from 2611 leads in 72h; all 38 were leak-site claims from ransomware.live, no non-claim stories. Closed 4 small private-company claims. Left 34 open. Kept as organisations of public importance (health, government, listed or large companies): Mid-Cumberland Human Resource Agency, Nephrology Associates, United Medical Doctors, NorthShore Health Centers, Aurora Health Management, Park Place Behavioral Health, Metropolitan Community Health Services, Ochsner Health, Orlando Health, Drive Medical, Greater Elgin Family Care Center, Mnfhs, FAIR Health, Clinica Pajonal group, Clinton Assessors Board, TrueBlue (two claims), Ginkgo Bioworks, CDM Smith, Gensler, Sonoco, Veritiv, Jeld-wen, AARP, alumil.com, Terminais, Egyptian Steel. Left open as ambiguous on size or sector (when in doubt, leave open): MedMira, The Vant Group, Noble Inc., Rober & Phillips, Laempe Reich, Pulsar, Osaki. Duplicate check on a sample of kept claims found no likely duplicates on file, except that Vortex claims for Apellis, Caris, Carrington/Mycorpass, Castle Biosciences and Molex already exist as claimed events. No story had a government source or three publishers, so there are no priority-1 open leads. The queue holds only claims, so the next sweep's work is claim research on the kept organisations.
